rca of the issue: Legacy Strategy Doctor v1 win-rate rules had auto-applied 'Restrict to reentry' setting classifier_action_whitelist=['reentry'], causing bot._enter_impl to skip every momentum entry ('skip <mint> [momentum_new]: action not in whitelist'). Fix cleared the whitelist, marked historical whitelist suggestions as reverted, added new config doctor_legacy_auto_apply_enabled (default False) to gate legacy v1 auto-apply, and added a hard guard that never auto-applies suggestions containing classifier_action_whitelist even when opted in. Verified: bot no longer skips due to whitelist, RH paper entries resumed, manual-buy endpoint returns ok:true, doctor no longer auto-applies legacy suggestions.
